author: cairn
blurb: Live and historical currency exchange rates (ECB data). No API key needed.

definition.name: Frankfurter FX
definition.description: Convert currencies and fetch reference exchange rates published by the European Central Bank, via the Frankfurter API.

operations.name: get_latest_rates
operations.description: Get the latest exchange rates for a base currency.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_latest_rates","description":"Latest currency exchange rates for a base currency.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"base":{"type":"string","description":"Base currency ISO code, e.g. 'USD' (default EUR)"},"symbols":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated target codes, e.g. 'GBP,JPY' (optional)"}},"required":[]}}

operations.name: convert_currency
operations.description: Get the exchange rate on a specific historical date for a base currency.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"convert_currency","description":"Historical exchange rates for a base currency on a date.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","description":"Date in YYYY-MM-DD"},"base":{"type":"string","description":"Base currency ISO code, e.g. 'USD'"},"symbols":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated target codes (optional)"}},"required":["date"]}}
